new_entities.name: LoanApplication
new_entities.description: A personal loan application record. Tracks the full lifecycle from submission to agreement execution or decline. Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core). The origination record for the consumer credit relationship.

fields.name: loan_amount
fields.description: Requested loan amount in GBP (£1,000–£25,000 for regulated credit)

fields.name: employment_status
fields.description: Employment status at time of application

fields.name: monthly_committed_expenditure
fields.description: Total monthly committed expenditure: rent/mortgage + existing credit + childcare + utilities (GBP)

fields.name: credit_score
fields.description: Credit bureau score — internal use only, not disclosed to customer

fields.name: risk_band
fields.description: Internal risk band from credit assessment

fields.name: decline_reason
fields.description: Reason for decline — used for UK GDPR Article 22 disclosure and CONC reporting

fields.name: approved_loan_amount
fields.description: Approved amount — may differ from requested if partial approval

fields.name: approved_apr
fields.description: Final approved APR — set by credit assessment

fields.name: monthly_repayment
fields.description: Monthly repayment amount — computed from loan_amount, term, approved_apr

fields.name: secci_acknowledged_at
fields.description: Timestamp when customer acknowledged the SECCI form

relationships.description: Many LoanApplications per Customer (one active at a time)
One LoanApplication may produce one LoanAgreement

new_entities.name: LoanAgreement
new_entities.description: The executed consumer credit agreement. Created when customer accepts the loan offer and signs electronically. Contains the legally binding terms. Owned by SVC-001.

fields.name: loan_account_id
fields.description: FK → LoanAccount (ENT-069) — set when drawdown occurs

fields.name: total_repayable
fields.description: Total amount repayable over the term

fields.name: first_repayment_date
fields.description: Date of first repayment (typically 30-31 days after drawdown)

fields.name: sca_assertion_ref
fields.description: SCA assertion reference for electronic signature — proves customer authenticated the agreement

fields.name: repayment_schedule
fields.description: Full repayment schedule: [{instalment_number, due_date, principal, interest, balance}]

relationships.description: One LoanAgreement produces one LoanAccount on drawdown

new_entities.name: LoanAccount
new_entities.description: The servicing account for a personal loan. Created when the loan is drawn down. Tracks the outstanding balance, repayment status, and arrears. Owned by SVC-001.

fields.name: arrears_amount
fields.description: Total amount in arrears — 0 if no arrears

fields.name: nominated_account_id
fields.description: FK → customer's current account that received the drawdown

relationships.description: Multiple LoanAccounts per Customer (one per loan product)

referenced_existing_entities.usage: Customer identity used across the loan lifecycle
